justification: Function is a simple per-net namespace lookup with no attacker-controlled data or memory operations.
analysis: This function simply retrieves a per-network namespace data structure using net_generic() with a fixed ID. There are no attacker-influenced inputs as the function only takes a kernel-provided net pointer and uses a static nfct_timeout_id. No memory is read, written, copied, indexed, allocated or freed within this function. The function performs a straightforward lookup operation without any bounds checking or arithmetic operations.
